method: Opened actual LeoCAD views in labelled browser review sheets; examined home composition, front elevation and site plan.
observations: A purple cone spire distinguishes the taller tower from the gabled study.
Small repeated gold accents connect the two roof forms; the garden stays secondary.
revisions: Added an upper window band and replaced the main gable with a supported cone spire.
scope: Exterior composition review; hidden interior interfaces and physical strength are not certified.
